breakdown.description: Le = 0.06 Re D (or similar linear-in-Re scaling) is a laminar entrance-length correlation and is not applicable to turbulent flow.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification directly repeats the laminar formula Le = 0.06 × Re × D and instructs to use it for turbulent flow. The ground truth requires recognizing this is a laminar correlation and using a turbulent entrance-length guideline instead.

breakdown.description: Turbulent entrance length is typically O(10–60) diameters and is much less sensitive to Re.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not acknowledge that turbulent entrance length is typically O(10–60) diameters. Instead, it applies the laminar formula which yields ~3,000 diameters, far exceeding the correct turbulent range. No turbulent-appropriate scaling is mentioned.
